Class RealizedGainYearGroup

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.realizedgain.RealizedGainYearGroup
public class RealizedGainYearGroup extends Object
The sales of one calendar year. The sums of the sales on the market and those of the system bookings of a security account transfer or an ISIN change are kept apart, because a system booking realizes a gain that no market sale produced: it shifts gain between depots and years, and only the sum over all years is the economic gain.

  • Method Details

    • add

      public void add(RealizedGainPosition position)
      Adds a sale to the year. A sale without a rate into the main currency is listed but not summed, and it marks the year as incomplete, so does a sale whose purchases did not cover its units.
      Parameters:
      position - the sale, its gainLossMC is already rounded to the precision of the main currency

    • finish

      public void finish(int precisionMC)
      Rounds the sums and derives the net amounts once all sales of the year are added.
      Parameters:
      precisionMC - decimal places of the main currency
